title: test(app-shell): give the new package-door matrix doubles the draft-overlaid read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VtLrLYVCgWS9LRTX72qamP)_
Fixes #27095

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:给两个新测试(#27010、#26837)的假客户端补上 `withPreviewDrafts`,只改测试,不改产品代码。
- 为什么改:#26840 让包内访问矩阵经草稿叠加读取对象,这两个测试与它交错合并,假客户端缺该方法,main 的 Test UI 因此变红。
- 风险与回滚:两行测试替身改动,零产品风险;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`PermissionMatrixEditor.objectGrantInherited-27010.test.tsx` 与 `PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorDraftBase-26837.test.tsx` 的 `makeClient`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.objectGrantInherited-27010 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorDraftBase-26837`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`withPreviewDrafts() { return this; }` added to the fake client of the two package-door matrix tests that merged beside #26840 (PR #27064): #27010's `objectGrantInherited-27010` and #26837's `packageDoorDraftBase-26837`. Same addition as the other matrix doubles. No product code changes.

## Why

Main went red on Test UI (shards 11 and 12) after queue merges crossed: #27064 made the package door read objects through `MetadataClient.withPreviewDrafts(true)`, and these two new tests' fakes did not have that method.

## Tests

- Red leg (the two files as on `main`): Test Files 2 failed, Tests 4 failed.
- Green leg: those two files plus `draftObjects-26840`: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 28 passed.
- Sweep: every app-shell test that mounts the matrix (74 files). They pass at `76e90df6` with the #27010 fix (714 tests). The other 36 files without `withPreviewDrafts` never mount the matrix under a `packageId`, so they never call it.

## Verification

Derived gates are in the os-dev report on #27095.
